jobs_results.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs_results.description:
Specific-Group is an International software development company, delivering custom software solutions for enterprise clients in Europe and USA. Our development centers are located in Austria, Belarus, Germany, Lithuania, Poland, and Spain. Our primary focus & areas of expertise is the financial domain. We deliver our solutions according to the latest technical standards for different industries and sectors, using new technologies and modern approaches.

Currently, we are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to join one of our projects in Specific-Group Spain.

Project description:

We are driving the design & implementation of a large independent sell-side advertising platform. All Top 20 Publishers use the platform to monetize their content across all screens and formats - including desktop, mobile, video, and ATV/CTV. All the leading agencies and more than 5.500 advertisers each month use the platform to access brand-safe, high-quality ad inventory and execute billions of... advertising transactions.

With over 600.000 transactions per second flowing through, the platform reaches millions of users every day. We develop everything in-house with a strong focus on quality and scalability.

Responsibilities:
• Development of a new project for the monitoring and maintenance of the current one based on Java technologies
• Handling the entire software development process from analysis, design, programming, testing to ongoing operation
• Analyze functional and non-functional requirements, create designs and detailed technical specifications
• Generate ideas and take an active role in the innovation process
• Work in an Agile process, in a self-organized, cross-functional team

Requirements:
• 4+ years of experience working with Java
• Hands-on experience with Java 8+: Spring/Spring Boot, Hibernate, TypeScript and Angular (is a must)
• Familiarity with modeling complex object structures
• Experience with frontend unit tests
• Experience with API design
• Exposure to designing performant microservice architectures
• Ability to write clean, maintainable code
• Good command of written and spoken English (Intermediate+)
• Strong communication skills, team player

Nice to have:
• Experience with NX (Mono-repository management tool)
• Optional knowledge of Angular Material Ag-Grid for data tables Highcharts

Benefits:
• Competitive salary
• Long-term projects
• Business trips
• Professional growth (professional trainings, knowledge sharing meet-ups, etc)
• Career perspectives
• Transparent and clear management
• Friendly colleagues and atmosphere
• Сorporate gifts on special events
• Company parties and team buildings
• Flexible working hours (you can start till 11am, duration of working week is 40h);
• Nice corporate equipment (incl. second monitor);
• Comfortable well-equipped office

jobs_results.title: Fullstack Engineer (NodeJS and Angular)
jobs_results.description:
Do you want to face new challenges without giving up the stability of a highly experienced technology group? At GMV we are expanding our Madrid and Seville teams in the space sector to take on software development projects related to satellite communication.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our team you will carry out software development with new and cutting-edge technologies in a Javascript environment oriented to microservices (Docker & Kubernetes), having close contact with the architects and coordinated with other developers under SCRUM methodologies.

With these tools, you will be involved in the development of new functionalities, as well as the evolution of existing products, in the interesting sector of satellite control centers.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

We are looking for a Telecommunications Engineer or Computer Scientist with 3-5 years of... experience in software development ( NodeJS and Angular ) to join our Agile teams for SATCOM (Satellite Communication) projects.

We expect you to bring technical knowledge and direction, use the right development methodologies and best practices, assess areas for improvement, review code, conduct unit tests and mentor younger team members.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Natalia Serrano Madrid, in charge of this vacancy.

nserrano.ext@gmv.com

Natalia Serrano Madrid

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Developer (Remote Spain)
jobs_results.description:
Cactus is a software development company, providing full-cycle services for the European market. More than 170 companies increased business productivity using solutions developed by Cactus programmers. The company has been regularly included in the listings of the best software development companies in Belgium and Europe.

Cactus is ready to expand the team with a Full Stack Developer in its hub in Seville. In this role, you will be vital in designing, developing, and maintaining mission-critical web applications and APIs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to drive architectural decisions, implement robust and scalable solutions, and ensure the delivery of high-quality software products.

What you will do:
• As a Full Stack Software Developer, you will play a crucial role in ingesting and transforming raw data into meaningful visual rithin your team to come up with solutions for challenging issues.
• Develop and maintain web applications using Ruby on Rails, ensuring... high quality and functionality.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver solutions.
• Conduct thorough testing and debugging across the full stack to ensure optimal performance.
• Design robust data models, ensuring data integrity and accuracy, and supporting user needs.
• Create intuitive visualizations and dashboards for stakeholder feedback.
• Stay updated on industry trends, participate in code reviews, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
